title: Household invite codes
pr_description: Owners can now invite people without knowing their user id: create_invite() issues a short shareable code, accept_invite() joins the caller to the household. Includes schema and tests.

defects.description: Invite codes are 6 hex chars (~16.7M values) from the predictable random module. auth.py consistently uses secrets for tokens; a guessable invite code lets strangers join households and read shared financial data.
accept_invite inserts the member directly and never checks MAX_MEMBERS, bypassing the cap that add_member enforces a screen up. Households can grow without bound through invites.

Accepted invites are never consumed or expired — no used_at update, no expiry check, no delete. One leaked code admits unlimited people forever. The invites table even has a used_at column that nothing writes.
